purpose: Improve the audited Kedro lineup-conditional series predictor and compare frozen forecasts with stored bookmaker probabilities without TEST-driven selection.
status_at_freeze: Original baseline and bookmaker reproduction completed; no new candidate has been evaluated.

cohort.unit: One complete native-HLTV-ID BO3/BO5 played series meeting existing exact-lineup eligibility.
cohort.split: Existing whole source-calendar-day 60/20/remainder split; unchanged IDs, orientation, target and source dates.
cohort.availability_limit: Historical played lineups, source dates and postgame records do not certify pre-event publication or executable forecasting. Date cutoffs are source-day conventions, not actual kickoff timestamps.

archive_features.eligibility: Existing _valid_series complete BO3/BO5 rule, native unique IDs, valid source dates, two nonempty distinct literal source team names; no roster requirement for history only.
archive_features.identity: Literal source team names only; no cross-source aliases, organization-ID claim, OpenCS2 crosswalk or nickname identity inference.
archive_features.era: Date >= 2024-01-01 is a modern-era proxy, not independently verified CS2 game-version certification.
archive_features.replay: Compute every source-day target feature before all same-day archive and player updates. Earlier evaluation-day outcomes may update following days. Fit/calibration coefficients remain TRAIN-only.
archive_features.cold_start: Neutral 1500 prior with explicit prior-match counts; read-only queries do not register unknown teams.
archive_features.inference: Persist both engines. Require explicit disjoint five-player rosters and forecast day strictly after the maximum saved player/archive history day. Reject obsolete state/artifact versions; no compatibility shim.

candidate_set.original_classifier_features: Retain original non-archive feature columns and original hyperparameters for an unchanged narrow-history comparison.
candidate_set.calibration: One nonnegative zero-intercept logit slope per prequential raw player-rating channel, fit by TRAIN log loss only; bounded from 0 to 3. Equal-strength probabilities remain 0.5 and reversed sides complement. If all TRAIN logits are zero use slope 1. No isotonic or in-sample classifier calibration.

compact_candidates.name: ridge_rating_logits
compact_candidates.transform: Clipped logit; TRAIN-only StandardScaler with_mean=false; LogisticRegression C=0.1, fit_intercept=false, random_state=42, max_iter=1000.

compact_candidates.name: ridge_strength_form
compact_candidates.transform: TRAIN-only StandardScaler with_mean=false; LogisticRegression C=0.1, fit_intercept=false, random_state=42, max_iter=1000.

candidate_set.reduced_schema_behavior: API tests/callers may supply the existing smaller explicit feature schema: omit archive-dependent recipes when their declared columns are absent; compact models use only their declared present columns. Never infer missing values or accept unknown mirror semantics.
controls: TRAIN-only literal class prior; diagnostic orientation-asymmetric control

selection.primary: Minimum VALIDATION log loss among the frozen 16 eligible candidates, committed before computing TEST scores.
selection.tie_break: Prefer incumbent pure_elo on an exact tie, then deterministic declared candidate order.
selection.fitting: TRAIN only; no TRAIN+VALIDATION refit after selection.
selection.development_diagnostics: Three expanding-origin folds entirely within TRAIN source days: first half is initial training prefix, remaining days divided into three consecutive blocks. Refit each candidate only on the preceding prefix; report skipped single-class prefixes. Diagnostic only, not an additional TEST-informed selection rule.
selection.test_policy: One frozen exploratory before/after evaluation; do not change features, hyperparameters, thresholds or promotion choice in response to TEST performance. Previously seen TEST is not an untouched prospective confirmation.
selection.reporting: All candidate validation and TEST log loss/Brier/accuracy/AUC, split and support details, inner-fold diagnostics, selected deployable recipe, same-ID selected-before versus selected-after paired source-day bootstrap uncertainty; 5000 draws, seed 42.

bookmaker_protocol.source: Existing data/app/app.sqlite3 opened read-only; no provider requests or app mutation.
bookmaker_protocol.primary: Existing latest-stored-observation, strict pre-start source-clock gates, native-ID/result/orientation checks, proportional de-vig; no fallback after an invalid latest observation.
sensitivities: Power de-vig on identical valid pairs: solve q1^a + q2^a = 1 per quote; exponent depends on prices only, never outcomes.

source_day cutoff: additionally require both quote source clocks and current receipt strictly before nominal source-day 00:00 UTC. Filter stored latest observations only; do not claim reconstructed earlier snapshots or certified matched information cutoffs.
bookmaker_protocol.table_rule: Per-book paired identical-ID model/book cohorts plus a separate all-books intersection; never rank books from differently sampled per-book scores.
bookmaker_protocol.uncertainty: Paired model-minus-book log loss and Brier on each per-book and all-book-common cohort; source-day block bootstrap 5000 draws seed 42. Empty scores/intervals null; singleton-day degeneracy disclosed.
bookmaker_protocol.interpretation: Stored source clocks and played-lineup conditioning do not certify obtainable quotes, closing prices, contemporary forecasts, CLV, execution or ROI. No outcome-selected de-vig recipe or market blend. No demonstrated edge without independent evidence.

excluded_scope: Fixing or replacing the unrelated generic CLI training pipeline
Claiming a universal CS log-loss floor
Claiming a fresh untouched TEST or prospective production readiness
